# Test fixtures

Small, synthetic data files used by contract and unit tests (no production data).

- `html/course-page.html` — course outline with a course-information table.
- `html/faculty-page.html` — faculty directory with headings and profile links.
- `html/announcements-page.html` — semester announcements with dates.
- `pdf/digital-course-outline.pdf` — minimal valid one-page text PDF.
- `pdf/scanned-past-paper-page.png` — tiny valid PNG standing in for a scanned page.
- `golden/mini-golden.json` — 10 golden questions in English, Urdu, and Roman Urdu.
